detail.goal: look up member 12345 and read their current savings balance

detail.why: Search Type must be "Member Number" because the given input 12345 is a member number, not an SSN fragment.
The Member ID textbox is the input for the member lookup; it is anchored to the "Member ID" label.

detail.target: button named "Search" follows "Search Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Submit the member inquiry to load the member's account record.
This is the balance cell in the same row as the "Savings" label in the Account/Balance table — the requested current savings balance.
Confirms the record shown belongs to the searched member ID; anchored to the "Member ID" label on the Member Detail screen.
Names the member whose balance was read, so the replayed result can be verified against the right person.

detail.summary: Searched Member Inquiry for member ID 12345 with Search Type "Member Number", landing on the Member Detail screen for Sarah Chen (Active). Read the Savings row of the Account/Balance table: current savings balance $4,182.55. Recorded outputs: savingsBalance, memberId, memberName. Checkpoint is the stable "Member Detail" heading rather than a balance figure, which changes between runs.
